description: This file implements a D-Bus manager class responsible for establishing and managing connections to the system D-Bus and creating proxies for various NetworkManager interfaces and objects within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A manager class that handles D-Bus connection setup, reconnection, and proxy creation for various NetworkManager components.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the D-Bus connection synchronously.

methods.description: Destructor that releases the D-Bus connection.

methods.name: DbusMgr::getConnection
methods.description: Returns the active GDBusConnection, reconnecting if necessary.

methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to the main NetworkManager D-Bus interface.

methods.name: DbusMgr::getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to the D-Bus Properties interface for a device.
